title: Celery and broad bean traybake with baked eggs

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Every ingredient is a whole food or a plain staple such as feta, eggs and olive oil, with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: New potatoes, celery, broad beans, eggs, feta, lemon and dill are all everyday supermarket buys in July.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray and simple roasting and egg-baking, well within a confident beginner's reach.

works.reason: 750g potatoes, a head of celery and eight eggs suit four, the 220°C roast and staged timings are sound, and the beans get about 15 minutes in total.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes of halving, chunking and podding is believable, and the 25, 5 and 8 to 10 minute stages add up to the 40 minutes of cooking.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed item is used, with the lemon as zest and juice and the pepper covered by 'Season', and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Roasted celery chunks lead a summery tray with new potatoes, broad beans and dill, which suits early July.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Potatoes, vegetables, eggs and feta make a balanced, filling family dinner.
